stemMd: A school wants to reduce lateness by starting classes fifteen minutes later. Which fact would most weaken the expectation that this will help?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The later start is easy to print on notices.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The buses used by most late students would also arrive fifteen minutes later under the new timetable.

explanationMd: The plan relies on extra time between arrival and class. If the main transport arrival shifts later by the same amount, that margin does not improve for most affected students. The fact directly undermines the proposed mechanism.

distractorRationale.a: Classroom count does not affect the proposed timing mechanism.
distractorRationale.d: This alone does not show the plan will fail for late students.
distractorRationale.e: Holidays do not address daily lateness.
distractorRationale.b: Administrative ease does not establish effectiveness.
